purpose: Shipped, hashed generation recipes for the card renderer (prepare_native_slepton). Each recipe names its process, spectrum, PDF, matching and decay choices; the renderer binds the masses and run controls the caller supplies. A recipe is a statement of how a sample is produced, not an admission of a physics operation: the native adapter still checks the process, the declared masses and the shower, and CHECK-IN 1 approval still precedes any generation.

slepton-bino-isrslep.description: Direct production of mass-degenerate charged sleptons in the MSSM_SLHA2 model with a bino-like lightest neutralino, one explicit ISR parton, unmerged leading order.
slepton-bino-isrslep.process: p p > chsleptons chsleptons j / susystrong @1 (the chsleptons multiparticle holds el, er, mul, mur, ta1 and ta2 of both charges; one explicit extra parton, no merging)
slepton-bino-isrslep.spectrum: All six charged-slepton masses equal MSLEP; the lightest neutralino mass is MN1; squarks, gluino, sneutrinos, charginos and heavier neutralinos at 4.5e9 GeV. The mixing blocks are those of the shipped parameter template: the model reads the physical masses and the slepton and neutralino mixing matrices from the card, so this is a supplied simplified-model spectrum, not a diagonalized MSSM spectrum.
slepton-bino-isrslep.decays: Explicit branching-ratio rows of 1.0 for slepton to lightest neutralino plus its lepton for el, er, mul, mur, ta1 and ta2, so Pythia imports a complete DECAY table. No width-only decay table is shipped.
slepton-bino-isrslep.matching: None: ickkw = 0 with xqcut and ktdurham at -1. The sample carries one explicit parton and is not an MLM or CKKW-L merged sample; a merged production needs a different native adapter.

MSLEP.meaning: common mass of the six charged sleptons

slepton-bino-isrslep.run_cuts: The recipe's run controls carry the jet cuts of the reference sample (ptj 20, ptj1min 50, mmjj 0, mmjjmax -1, deltaeta 0). A configuration that declares [madgraph.run.options] overrides them key by key; dropping the cut block changes the tagged cross section by about a factor of two.

source.param_template: mapyde 0.5.0 cards/param/SleptonBino.slha (Apache-2.0); the six slepton masses and the neutralino mass are the placeholders MSLEP and MN1
source.shower_card: mapyde 0.5.0 cards/pythia/pythia8_card.dat (Apache-2.0), the MadGraph-interface card the native shower wrapper translates for unmerged LO
